2608.26088.title: Planetary Prediction Engine: Autonomous Geospatial Prediction via Intelligent Data Selection and Foundation Model Embeddings
2608.26088.paper_summary: Addressing critical global challenges, from food security and disaster risk to disease outbreaks and socio-economic vulnerability, demands high-fidelity geospatial modeling. However, building predictive planetary models remains bottlenecked by a fragmented data ecosystem, requiring manual data retrieval, multimodal data curation and fusion along with iterative model selection. We present the Planetary Prediction Engine (PPE), an autonomous AI system that executes this end-to-end workflow directly from natural-language queries. PPE synthesizes multimodal datasets on the fly, retrieving spatiotemporally relevant covariates across open-web and Earth observation platforms (Data Commons, Google Earth Engine) and fusing them with geospatial foundation model embeddings (PDFM, AlphaEarth). Simultaneously, it searches over task-tailored model architecture families with automated overfitting guards. Across diverse tasks, geographies, and scientific domains, PPE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art or manually tuned expert baselines. For US spatial regression, PPE improves mean $R^2$ across 21 CDC health indicators (76.8% vs. 60.0%), FEMA national risk indices (64.9% vs. 60.0%), and the Social Vulnerability Index (66.2% vs. 58.6%). For spatial downscaling in data-scarce settings, PPE integrates localized proxies to double baseline accuracy in Nigerian food security indicators ($R^2$ of 66.1% vs. 31.5%). For epidemiological nowcasting of the 2026 DRC Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, PPE achieves a Recall@10 of 83.3% (identifying 15 of 18 newly invaded health zones across five weekly forecasts), a +10.3 percentage-point improvement over the public state-of-the-art modeling (~73%). By combining autonomous multimodal planetary data discovery with targeted model optimization, PPE lowers the technical barrier to planetary-scale analytics, enabling rapid, customized, expert-level deployment.
2608.26088.paper_summary_zh: 解決全球重大挑戰，包括糧食安全、災害風險、疾病爆發和社會經濟脆弱性，需求高保真度的地理空間建模。<lb/>然而，建立預測性行星模型仍然受到碎片化數據生態系統的瓶頸，這需要手動數據檢索、多模態數據策劃和融合，以及迭代模型選擇。<lb/>我們提出了行星預測引擎（PPE），這是一個自主的人工智慧系統，能夠直接從自然語言查詢執行這一端到端的工作流程。<lb/>PPE 即時合成多模態數據集，從開放網絡和地球觀測平台（數據公共、Google Earth Engine）檢索時空相關的協變量，並將其與地理空間基礎模型嵌入（PDFM、AlphaEarth）融合。<lb/>同時，它在自動過擬合防護的情況下，搜尋針對任務量身定製的模型架構家族。<lb/>在多樣的任務、地理區域和科學領域中，PPE 始終超越最先進或手動調整的專家基準。<lb/>對於美國的空間回歸，PPE 在 21 項 CDC 健康指標上提高了平均 $R^2$（76.8% 對 60.0%）、FEMA 國家風險指數（64.9% 對 60.0%）和社會脆弱性指數（66.2% 對 58.6%）。<lb/>在數據稀缺的環境中進行空間下採樣時，PPE 整合了本地化的代理，將尼日利亞糧食安全指標的基準準確率提高了一倍（$R^2$ 為 66.1% 對 31.5%）。<lb/>對於 2026 年剛果民主共和國 Bundibugyo 埃博拉疫情的流行病學即時預測，PPE 實現了 83.3% 的 Recall@10（在五次每週預測中識別出 15 個新入侵的健康區域中的 18 個），比公共最先進模型提高了 10.3 個百分點（約 73%）。<lb/>通過將自主的多模態行星數據發現與針對性的模型優化相結合，PPE 降低了行星級分析的技術門檻，使快速、定制的專家級部署成為可能。
